summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing PDMR dealings. On 21 September 2026, Sharesave Scheme 2017 options were granted at 99.52 pence per share to CFO William Chalmers (7,813 shares), Amanda Murphy (18,086) and Jasjyot Singh (18,086); PDMR Chirantan Barua sold 80,810 shares at 110.40 pence. These are routine employee-plan and notification transactions, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. Watch only for aggregate insider-sentiment drift.
